visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a static shot of a stone fountain featuring a dark statue of a creature, surrounded by lily pads in a clear pond. Lush green lawns, manicured hedges, and palm trees frame a distant blue lake and mountains under a clear sunny sky. (2) A woman with long reddish-brown hair appears, wearing a beige sleeveless vest and matching shorts, a white and brown patterned scarf on her head, and white-rimmed sunglasses. She leans against a vintage orange open-top car parked on a stone-paved driveway overlooking the lake. (3) The woman walks down stone steps toward the camera, holding a grey tote bag; the orange car and mountain lake remain in the background. (4) Close-up shot of the woman sitting at an outdoor table with a striped yellow umbrella; she adjusts her sunglasses and looks toward the lake. (5) A server's hand places a three-tiered silver dessert stand onto a marble table; the stand contains various small pastries and sweets. (6) A high-angle panning shot reveals a sprawling, tiered green garden with white tables, a central fountain, and a panoramic view of Lake Como and the surrounding green mountains. (7) The woman is seen from behind, carrying a large beige tote bag and walking up wide stone stairs toward a grand light-colored villa with yellow awnings.
